sources.title: AWQ: Activation-aware Weight Quantization for LLM Compression and Acceleration
sources.snippet: Large language models (LLMs) have transformed numerous AI applications. On-device LLM is becoming increasingly important: running LLMs locally on edge devices can reduce the cloud computing cost and protect users' privacy. However, the astronomical model size and the limited hardware resource pose significant deployment challenges.
